angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 2,773,060 km at 70.56 pc = 0.53 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 80687: distance 70.558 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.03), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 70.558 +/- 2.117 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 14.2059 +/- 0.0206 mas (same row, RUWE 1.06), 690.2 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 3.986 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 80687: radius 3.986 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 8.501 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.059) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 2,773,060 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4940 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 80687: effective temperature 4940 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.045) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 80687: effective temperature 4940 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.045) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433)
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 148427 (pscomppars): spectral type K0 III- IV, from Piccinini et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...707A.104P/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 148427: main object type RG*, Red Giant Branch star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 148427 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.154 dex, from Fischer et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...703.1545F/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 148427 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.78, from Fischer et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...703.1545F/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 148427 (pscomppars): age 2.5 Gyr, from Fischer et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...703.1545F/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 148427 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.13 km/s, from Fischer et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...703.1545F/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.

surfaceGravitySource: log g 3.48 from 2024A&A...683A.125P; the 14 published values span log g 3.3 to 3.61, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.1% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A%26A...683A.125P)
